name: Sacred Synergy (Psionic)
body:
The gods of the loud ones are strange, but they are real, and powerful—one would do well to respect them.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 1 rank, qit’ar

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can regain power points from a cure spell equal to the spell’s level. When used in this way, the number of hit points regained is halved. Half-breed Hardiness The qit’ar suffer us half-breeds with ill grace, sometimes; but sometimes, we don’t have to take it…

Prerequisite(s): Qit’ar, must not possess a psionic reserve

Benefit(s): You gain +2 racial bonus to all saves vs. psionic powers.
